segmentName: Low-voltage BLDC motors & controllers for light EVs (India)

market.domesticSlice: figures are India-specific; this is primarily a domestic-demand story tied to India's own EV adoption curve

subSegments.name: Electric two-wheelers
subSegments.note: Largest share of the India EV motor market by volume — 1.40 million units sold in FY2025-26, driven by India's large two-wheeler base and urban scooter adoption.

structureFacts: Electric mobility and robotics are named as the two key growth propellers expanding the application base for low-voltage motors — compact design, high torque density, and thermal management are the technical axes buyers care about.
Electric two-wheelers lead EV component demand by volume in India (1.40M units, FY2025-26), making that the largest single demand pool for this component category.

adoptionStructure.note: Demand is driven by design-in relationships with EV OEMs (B2B), not direct consumer purchase — a company at this tier succeeds by being specified into other companies' vehicles, not by winning end-customers directly.

peers.name: Compage Automation
peers.note: BLDC/PMSM motors for EV applications, 400W to 22kW, 24V to 144V range — a broader power/voltage range than Gremot's stated <100V focus. No financials found.

peers.name: Shakti Pumps
peers.note: BLDC motor production capacity of 20,000 motors/month; currently making motors and controllers for electric 3-wheelers. A much larger-scale operation (an established pump manufacturer diversifying into EV motors). No EV-specific financials found.

peers.name: Sona Comstar
peers.note: A large, listed component maker — BLDC/PMSM motors, motor controllers, e-axles, with a technology partnership with Equipmake (UK) for patented powertrain tech. Operates at a vastly larger scale than Gremot; included here as the top of the competitive range, not a close peer.

peers.name: Tsuyo
peers.note: Full EV powertrain solutions across bike, e-scooter, 3W, and 4W applications — broader vehicle-class coverage than Gremot's light-EV/<100V focus. No financials found.

drivers: Technical fit: compact design, high torque density, thermal management — named as the specific attributes buyers select on.
Design-in relationships with EV OEMs, since this is a B2B component sale, not a direct-to-consumer product.
Production capacity and reliability at volume, once past the design-in stage (e.g. Shakti Pumps' 20,000 motors/month capacity as a benchmark).
customerValue.strongestPredictor: Winning and keeping OEM design-in slots — the component-tier equivalent of the certification-gating seen in other segments researched, but relationship/spec-driven rather than registry-driven.

steps: propose a motor/controller spec fit for the application
design and engineer motor/controller technology (e.g. IPM, FOC control)
compete for and win innovation grants/incubation
plan production against OEM order forecasts
onboard as a qualified component supplier
maintain the relationship for the next vehicle generation
demand arises from OEM vehicle production plans
recurring reorder tied to OEM production volumes

sources: Mobility Foresights, IMARC Group (India low-voltage electric motor market sizing)
Bauaelectric, MarkNtel Advisors (BLDC motor manufacturer landscape, EV motor market)
